daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

Former President Jokowi's evolving position on support for a second Prabowo-Gibran term has triggered political analysis. Golkar stated that Jokowi's different statements reflected mature considerations, while observers suggested the shift was strategic rather than a sign of coalition fracture. President Prabowo himself convened a meeting at Hambalang where he instructed acceleration of 100 fishing village projects.

  • The Presidential Advisory Council (Wantimpres) expanded its working commissions to six to broaden its advisory scope.
  • DPR Speaker Puan Maharani called for a stronger IPU role in promoting global peace during an international parliamentary meeting.
  • Indonesia is expediting narcotics law revision to address severe prison overcrowding caused by drug offenders.
  • PDI Perjuangan's Malang branch will soon establish a Quranic school named after Puan Maharani.
  • Said Abdullah emphasized that PDI Perjuangan distributes aid beyond just electoral cycles when handing out 1,000 food packages in Malang.
  • The National Human Rights Commission received 42 complaints related to violations in correctional facilities.

Foreign Policy & Defence

Indonesia is bidding for a seat on the ICAO Council, bringing President Prabowo's vision to the international aviation stage. The Indonesian government intensified protection of Indonesian citizens in Saudi Arabia following conflict escalation in the region and warned Indonesian nationals to remain vigilant amid Saudi-Houthi hostilities. Indonesia also pushed for improved welfare of Indonesian migrant workers in Malaysia.

  • Indonesia pledged a stronger UNESCO role to support Global South nations in international forums.
  • Indonesia and Airbus strengthened the national aerospace ecosystem through enhanced cooperation.
  • A review article highlighted two years of military modernization under the Prabowo-Gibran administration.
  • The TNI detained Lieutenant Colonel A after his official residence was rented out and used as an online gambling headquarters.
  • Indonesia won the overall championship at the ISCG 2026 sports-culture competition in Pakistan.

Other

The government is drafting a decree to transfer Whoosh high-speed rail shares to the Finance Ministry, a significant move in infrastructure governance. Indonesia secured Rp45.7 trillion in development funding from the Islamic Development Bank. President Prabowo launched 11 downstreaming projects worth Rp180 trillion at the Indonesia Weda Bay Industrial Park.

  • Recruitment for 464,856 civil servant teacher positions will begin in 2027 with deployment starting in 2028.
  • Non-tax state revenue grew 41.7 percent to Rp492.3 trillion, the Finance Minister reported.
  • Energy subsidies and compensation have reached 84.3 percent of the 2026 target, according to the minister.
  • Mount Anak Krakatau erupted, prompting authorities to warn the public to maintain a safe distance.
  • The Transportation Minister stated that a presidential decree on ride-hailing will provide legal certainty for drivers.
